style_base: Simple crude hand-drawn cartoon in the style of the 'Ecomonos' youtube channel. A recurring friendly brown cartoon monkey character with a lighter tan belly and face, big round white eyes with black pupils, thick bold black outlines, flat simple colors, deliberately simple and slightly rough but charming and funny, expressive exaggerated faces. Pure white background, lots of empty white space, minimalist, comedy tone. The SAME monkey character appears consistently in every image. CRITICAL TEXT RULE: prefer NO text, labels or signs at all — tell the scene through the monkey's action and expression and simple symbols. If a short text is truly necessary it MUST be in perfect SPANISH exactly as specified, in large simple hand-drawn block letters — NEVER English, NEVER any other language.
note: Estilo Ecomonos (mono cartoon). Motor: Gemini flash via Vertex AI (credito Google Cloud). 168 escenas.
